cautions.en: This body is a construction, not a scan of one person: her real skeleton (Visible Human Female CT) carries male soft tissue deformed to fit it. Only the 86 parts marked "scanned" are her own anatomy; 3215 parts are warped male anatomy.
cautions.zh: 本模型是拼合构建的，并非某一位女性的完整扫描：骨骼来自女性真实 CT（Visible Human Female），其上的软组织则由男性模型形变贴合而成。只有标为“扫描”的 86 个部件是她本人的解剖结构，另有 3215 个部件是形变后的男性结构。

cautions.en: Warped parts are anchored by bone only. Between bones their position is extrapolated: expect errors of 1–3 cm for limb muscles, vessels and nerves, and more in the abdomen and pelvis.
cautions.zh: 形变部件仅以骨骼为锚点，骨与骨之间的位置靠外推得到：四肢的肌肉、血管和神经误差约 1–3 cm，腹部和盆腔更大。

cautions.en: Pelvic soft tissue is not female anatomy: the uterus, ovaries, tubes and vagina are artist-modelled (Human Reference Atlas), while the bowel, vessels, nerves and pelvic floor around them are male structures moved aside. The sigmoid colon was shifted up to 5 cm to clear the uterus and left ovary; still overlapping: Cervicovaginal junction 10% (Rectum), Vagina 15% (Right puborectalis).
cautions.zh: 盆腔软组织并非真实的女性解剖：子宫、卵巢、输卵管和阴道为美术建模（Human Reference Atlas），其周围的肠管、血管、神经和盆底肌则是被推移开的男性结构。乙状结肠为避让子宫和左卵巢被移动了最多约 5 cm；目前仍有重叠：Cervicovaginal junction 10% (Rectum)、Vagina 15% (Right puborectalis)。

cautions.en: The body surface is synthetic: male skin deformed to her skeleton and raised into a smooth envelope over the breasts. It does not show female body shape or fat distribution. The breasts themselves are a standing-shape artist model.
cautions.zh: 体表是合成的：男性皮肤按她的骨骼形变后，再在乳房处抬高成平滑包络，并不反映女性的体形和脂肪分布。乳房本身是站立位形态的美术模型。
皮下脂肪层是在上述合成体表与她的肌肉、骨骼、器官外包络之间按 3 mm 体素填充得到的（最深只算到皮下 3 cm），并非扫描所得；其厚度取决于合成的皮肤，不代表女性真实的脂肪分布。
cautions.en: The subcutaneous fat layer fills the gap between that synthetic body surface and the outer envelope of her muscles, bones and organs at 3 mm voxels (no deeper than 3 cm below the skin); it is not scanned, and its thickness follows the synthetic skin rather than a real female fat distribution.

Missing: external genitalia and perineum, female urethra, ovarian and vaginal vessels. Male-only parts (prostate, testes, penis, seminal vesicles, testicular vessels, male urethra) were removed, not replaced.
cautions.zh: 缺失：外生殖器和会阴、女性尿道、卵巢血管和阴道血管。男性特有结构（前列腺、睾丸、阴茎、精囊、睾丸血管、男性尿道）已删除，但未以对应的女性结构替代。

cautions.en: Pose is reconstructed: the donor was scanned lying down with bent elbows and pointed feet, and each bone was moved rigidly into a standing pose. Joint spaces at the elbow, knee, ankle and shoulder are approximate, and the scapulae and clavicles keep their lying-down position.
cautions.zh: 姿势是重建的：供体扫描时为仰卧、屈肘、足跖屈，各骨被逐一刚性移动到站立姿势。肘、膝、踝、肩的关节间隙只是近似，肩胛骨和锁骨仍保持仰卧时的位置。

cautions.en: Right radius, ulna and the bones of both hands and feet are not her scanned bones: the right forearm is a mirrored copy of the left (the scan cut it off), and hand and foot bones are warped male bones with extended fingers.
cautions.zh: 右侧桡骨、尺骨以及双手、双足的骨并非她的扫描骨：右前臂是左前臂的镜像（扫描视野将其截断），手骨和足骨是形变后的男性骨，手指呈伸直状。

cautions.en: She has six lumbar vertebrae. The first is shown as "Supernumerary lumbar vertebra"; her second to sixth carry the names of the first to fifth. Rib numbering comes from automatic segmentation and is unreliable for left ribs 5–9.
cautions.zh: 她有六节腰椎：第一节显示为“额外腰椎”，第二至第六节沿用第一至第五腰椎的名称。肋骨编号来自自动分割，左侧第 5–9 肋的编号不可靠。

cautions.en: Her scanned organs (kidneys, spleen, pancreas, adrenals, gallbladder, bladder, gluteal muscles) are in lying-down, post-mortem position and do not always meet the warped vessels and ducts that should connect to them. Lungs, heart, liver, stomach and bowel are warped male organs.
cautions.zh: 她的扫描器官（肾、脾、胰、肾上腺、胆囊、膀胱、臀肌）处于仰卧、死后的位置，与本应相连的形变血管和管道不一定对得上。肺、心、肝、胃和肠是形变后的男性器官。

cautions.en: Everything said about the male model also applies to the warped parts: nerves, ligaments and lymph nodes are artist-modelled with schematic nerve thickness; phrenic nerve, pleura, pericardium, spinal cord, menisci and cruciate ligaments are absent.
cautions.zh: 男性模型的各项注意事项同样适用于形变部件：神经、韧带和淋巴结为美术建模，神经粗细仅为示意；膈神经、胸膜、心包、脊髓、半月板和交叉韧带缺失。

notes: This body is a construction, not a scan of one person: her real skeleton (Visible Human Female CT) carries male soft tissue deformed to fit it. Only the 86 parts marked "scanned" are her own anatomy; 3215 parts are warped male anatomy.
Warped parts are anchored by bone only. Between bones their position is extrapolated: expect errors of 1–3 cm for limb muscles, vessels and nerves, and more in the abdomen and pelvis.

The sigmoid colon was shifted up to 5 cm to clear the uterus and left ovary; still overlapping: Cervicovaginal junction 10% (Rectum), Vagina 15% (Right puborectalis).

The body surface is synthetic: male skin deformed to her skeleton and raised into a smooth envelope over the breasts. It does not show female body shape or fat distribution. The breasts themselves are a standing-shape artist model.

The subcutaneous fat layer fills the gap between that synthetic body surface and the outer envelope of her muscles, bones and organs at 3 mm voxels (no deeper than 3 cm below the skin); it is not scanned, and its thickness follows the synthetic skin rather than a real female fat distribution.

Missing: external genitalia and perineum, female urethra, ovarian and vaginal vessels. Male-only parts (prostate, testes, penis, seminal vesicles, testicular vessels, male urethra) were removed, not replaced.

Pose is reconstructed: the donor was scanned lying down with bent elbows and pointed feet, and each bone was moved rigidly into a standing pose. Joint spaces at the elbow, knee, ankle and shoulder are approximate, and the scapulae and clavicles keep their lying-down position.

Right radius, ulna and the bones of both hands and feet are not her scanned bones: the right forearm is a mirrored copy of the left (the scan cut it off), and hand and foot bones are warped male bones with extended fingers.

She has six lumbar vertebrae. The first is shown as "Supernumerary lumbar vertebra"; her second to sixth carry the names of the first to fifth. Rib numbering comes from automatic segmentation and is unreliable for left ribs 5–9.

Her scanned organs (kidneys, spleen, pancreas, adrenals, gallbladder, bladder, gluteal muscles) are in lying-down, post-mortem position and do not always meet the warped vessels and ducts that should connect to them. Lungs, heart, liver, stomach and bowel are warped male organs.

Everything said about the male model also applies to the warped parts: nerves, ligaments and lymph nodes are artist-modelled with schematic nerve thickness; phrenic nerve, pleura, pericardium, spinal cord, menisci and cruciate ligaments are absent.
